Price Integrity Dashboard

Live

Flags vendors charging above the national receiving price, and outlets selling below the expected shelf price, both measured against an adjustable deviation threshold. Includes category and zone breakdowns and a district-level Bangladesh heatmap to spot where pricing discipline needs attention.

Receiving Intelligence Dashboard

Live

Scores every article–outlet combination for over- and under-receiving risk against sales pace and stock cover, so the supply chain team works the worst cases first instead of scanning every line by hand.

Under Margin Dashboard

In development

Traces a margin shortfall back to its cause — a sale-price problem or a buying-price problem — by comparing both sides against national deviation before the loss reaches P&L.
